title: 第3章 这是一场鏖战第4章 傲傲傲傲傲傲娇
content_zh:
;;
帮啊！为什么不帮？
女人是会影响自己拔刀的速度，但除开对方是女生这个身份外，对方也是自己的同乡啊。
正所谓在家靠父母，在外靠朋友，两人从小相识，以后进入玄天门，走上修仙路后也可以互相帮衬。
举手之劳，能帮就帮呗。
天玄大陆，登天梯脚下。
苏沐雪活动着右脚的脚踝，深吸一口气后，眼神坚定的看向面前这宽阔雄壮的登天梯。
区区脚崴罢了，自己前世可是登上女帝之位的一代仙帝！
就这点小挫伤，又怎么能拦得住自己？！
想完，苏沐雪就要迈出自己的左脚，踏上这直入云霄的登天梯。
可在将全身的重量都压在右脚脚腕上的一瞬间，苏沐雪就觉得自己右脚一软，感觉支撑不住想要倒下去。
完了，难道自己重走修仙路的第一步就要跌倒吗？
就在这时，苏沐雪突然一股力量从身后传来，撑起自己将要倒下的身体。
扭头一看，竟看见一张自己熟悉，却又仇恨的脸庞。
是云阳！
“你！！”
苏沐雪美目微张，怒目而视，下意识到就要挣脱云阳托住自己的肩膀。
可云阳的肩膀就好像铁铸的一般，任她如何挣脱却也挣脱不开云阳的肩膀。
甚至还被云阳带着往上走。
“等！唔！”

被云阳拖着走的苏沐雪娇嗔一声，脸上也不由得浮现一一抹红霞。
该死！自己在想什么？！
苏沐雪轻咬朱唇，奋力想要挣脱开云阳的肩膀。
“别动。”
云阳则十分强势的说了一句，然后继续揽着苏沐雪的腰往上走。
看着云阳的侧脸，苏沐雪最后也没再说什么，在云阳的支撑下继续向上走去。
他似乎……和前世不太一样啊。
可搀扶着另一个人攀登“天梯”可不是那么容易的事，估计登上几十阶他就会受不了了吧。
估计过不了一会就会把自己甩到一旁了。
但苏沐雪却没想到，云阳可是个音游小高手！
没错！登天梯的过程对于蓝星的云阳来说，就是打音游。
打一款古老的经典音游——钢琴块。
又称别踩白块。
在选择登上天梯的那一刻，这个“病毒游戏”就弹出了个钢琴块游戏，想让游戏人物在天梯上攀登的更高，那就要在这个游戏里获得更高的分数。
而选择帮助苏沐雪，则会让原本从屏幕上方落下的方块改成从屏幕上方三分之一的地方落下。
可供云阳反应的时间缩短了三分之一。
但对于一个曾挑战过《冰与火之歌》的人来说，区区黑白块，不可能失误的！
看我狂砍你一万分！

Help! Why not help?
Women will affect the speed of drawing the sword, but apart from the fact that the other party is a girl, the other party is also a fellow countryman.
As the saying goes, rely on your parents at home and rely on friends outside. The two have known each other since childhood, and they can help each other after they enter Xuantianmen and embark on the path of cultivating immortals.
It's a little effort, if you can help, please help.
Tianxuan Continent, at the foot of the ladder to heaven.
Su Muxue moved her right ankle, took a deep breath, and looked firmly at the wide and majestic ladder in front of her.
It's just a sprain in my ankle. In my previous life, I was an Immortal Emperor who ascended to the position of empress!
With this little bruise, how could he stop himself? !
After thinking about it, Su Muxue was about to take out her left foot and step on the ladder that goes straight into the sky.
But the moment Su Muxue put her whole body weight on her right ankle, she felt her right foot was weak, and she felt like she couldn't support it and wanted to fall down.
It’s over, will I fall down on my first step on the road to cultivating immortality again?
At this moment, Su Muxue suddenly felt a force coming from behind, supporting her body that was about to fall.
Turning around, he saw a face that he was familiar with, but also filled with hatred.
It’s Yunyang!
"You!!"
Su Muxue's beautiful eyes opened slightly and she glared angrily. She subconsciously wanted to break away from Yunyang's support on her shoulders.
But Yunyang's shoulders were as if they were made of iron. No matter how she tried to break free, she couldn't break free from Yunyang's shoulders.
He was even led up by Yunyang.
"Wait! Uh!"
Su Muxue, who was dragged away by Yunyang, let out a squeak, and a touch of red glow appeared on her face.
Damn it! What are you thinking about? !
Su Muxue bit her red lips and tried hard to break away from Yunyang's shoulders.
"Don't move."
Yunyang said something very forcefully, and then continued to walk up with his arms around Su Muxue's waist.
Looking at Yunyang's side face, Su Muxue said nothing in the end and continued walking upward with Yunyang's support.
He seems...different from his previous life.
But supporting another person to climb the "ladder to heaven" is not that easy. He may not be able to bear it after climbing dozens of steps.
I guess he will throw himself aside after a while.
But Su Muxue didn't expect that Yunyang was a master of music games!
That's right! For Blue Star's Yunyang, the process of climbing the ladder is like playing music games.
Play an old classic music game - Piano Tiles.
Also known as Don’t Step on the White Block.
The moment you choose to climb the ladder, this "viral game" pops up a piano tiles game. If you want the game character to climb higher on the ladder, you must get a higher score in this game.
Choosing to help Su Muxue will cause the blocks that originally fell from the top of the screen to fall from the top third of the screen.
The time available for Yunyang to react was shortened by one third.
But for someone who has challenged "A Song of Ice and Fire", it is impossible to make a mistake with just black and white blocks!
Watch me score you ten thousand points!
